description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, adding {B}{B} and then an amount of additional {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Returned Pastcaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
